basic_information.name: Salesforce Agentforce
basic_information.creator: Salesforce
basic_information.release_date: September 2024 (announced at Dreamforce 2024); GA October 2024. Major releases: Agentforce 2 (December 2024), Agentforce 2dx (March 2025), Agentforce 3 (June 2025), Agentforce 360 (October 2025, Dreamforce 2025). Spring '26 release rolling out February 2026.
basic_information.current_version: Agentforce 360 (Spring '26 release, rolling out February 2026). Agentforce 360 is the umbrella brand encompassing the latest platform capabilities.

technical_architecture.architecture_pattern: orchestrator, graph_based, event_driven. The Atlas Reasoning Engine is the central orchestrator built with asynchronous, event-driven, graph-based workflows using cooperative agent swarms. It employs a modular architecture with planners, action selectors, memory modules, and reflection loops. Declarative YAML configuration files define agent roles, behaviors, and states.
technical_architecture.underlying_models: Model-agnostic platform supporting multiple LLM providers. Default: Salesforce-managed mix of models (currently including OpenAI GPT-4o). AWS-hosted option: Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4 on Amazon Bedrock. Additional supported models from OpenAI (GPT-4, GPT-5 via October 2025 partnership), Anthropic (Claude family), Google, and Azure OpenAI. Bring Your Own LLM (BYOLLM) Open Connector allows connection to any language model including custom-built models, IBM Granite, Databricks DBRX, and open-source models. Einstein Studio enables custom AI model creation from Salesforce data.
technical_architecture.tool_integration: Native MCP (Model Context Protocol) client support (pilot July 2025) enabling connection to any MCP-compliant server without custom code. A2A (Agent-to-Agent Protocol) support for cross-platform agent interoperability. AgentExchange marketplace for pre-built agents, skills, tools, and resources. Enterprise-grade MCP Server registry with security policy enforcement, rate-limiting, and access protocols. Custom actions via prompt templates, Apex code, or Models API. Integration with Salesforce ecosystem (Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Data Cloud).
technical_architecture.planning_approach: ReAct (Reasoning and Acting) style evaluation. Atlas pulls structured and unstructured data from Salesforce Data Cloud, generates a plan of action, assesses whether the plan achieves the goal, then loops through evaluation-refinement cycles until confident. Hybrid reasoning via Agent Script combines deterministic workflows (required business logic runs sequentially) with flexible LLM reasoning for nuance. Implements 'System 2' inference-time reasoning for improved accuracy and reduced hallucinations.
technical_architecture.multi_agent_support: Yes, cooperative agent swarms architecture. Multi-agent systems with task decomposition and delegation. A2A protocol provides agents with digital identity and structured collaboration framework for decomposing complex tasks and delegating responsibilities. AgentExchange enables discovery and connection of agents from different providers. Multi-agent adoption projected to surge 67% by 2027 according to Salesforce's Connectivity Report.

memory_and_context.memory_types_supported: short_term (conversation context), semantic (knowledge from Data Cloud — structured and unstructured enterprise data), episodic (past interaction history via CRM records). Atlas memory modules are part of the modular architecture. Data 360 serves as the unified data layer providing agent context from across the enterprise.
memory_and_context.context_window_management: Intelligent Context feature extracts and structures information from complex, unstructured sources for accurate, relevant responses. Low-code pipeline for unstructured, multimodal data processing. Data Cloud provides real-time data retrieval and grounding. Dynamic grounding through Einstein Trust Layer ensures responses are anchored in enterprise data.
memory_and_context.persistence_mechanism: cloud. Agent state persisted via Salesforce Data Cloud (cloud-native). CRM records, knowledge articles, and enterprise data serve as persistent context. Conversation history maintained in Salesforce platform.
memory_and_context.context_engineering_approach: Context is a first-class architectural concern. Data 360 is specifically designed as the 'trusted, unified data layer that gives every agent context.' Intelligent Context processes multimodal unstructured data (documents, images, etc.) to provide agents with relevant job-specific context. Agentic Enterprise Search unifies search, collaboration, and action in a single interface for contextual agent responses.

capabilities.core_capabilities: Autonomous AI agents for enterprise CRM workflows across sales, service, marketing, commerce, and IT. Key capabilities include: (1) Customer Service — handles Tier-1 and Tier-2 inquiries, resolves issues, updates records, escalates when necessary; Reddit achieved 46% case deflection and 84% faster resolution. (2) Sales Operations — pipeline monitoring, deal follow-up, meeting scheduling, opportunity stage updates, outreach email drafting. (3) Lead Management — intent signal analysis, engagement history processing, firmographic data analysis for automatic lead qualification. (4) Prospecting — 24/7 automated prospecting, data enrichment from web and external sources, prioritized prospect lists. (5) Order Management — product discovery, pricing adjustments, order modifications, returns handling. (6) Account Management — instant comprehensive customer views pulling from Salesforce data, third-party data, and conversations. (7) Agentforce Voice — AI-powered voice across phone, web, and mobile with brand customization. (8) Agentic Setup and Data Management — natural language orchestration of data pipelines. (9) Agentforce Builder — conversational workspace for building, testing, and refining agents with AI guidance, low-code canvas, and pro-code options.
capabilities.supported_modalities: Text, voice (Agentforce Voice across phone/web/mobile), code (Apex, LWC), structured data, unstructured documents (via Intelligent Context multimodal pipeline). Browser-based agent interactions.
capabilities.autonomy_level: human_in_loop to fully_autonomous depending on configuration. Agent Script enables hybrid reasoning: deterministic workflows for critical business logic with LLM flexibility for nuanced interactions. Configurable escalation to human agents based on complexity or confidence thresholds.
capabilities.tool_ecosystem: Extensive Salesforce ecosystem integration. AgentExchange marketplace with pre-built agents, skills, and tools. Native connectors to all Salesforce Clouds (Sales, Service, Marketing, Commerce, Data Cloud). MCP support enables connection to any MCP-compliant external tool. A2A protocol for cross-platform agent collaboration. Custom tool creation via Apex, prompt templates, and Models API. Third-party integrations with enterprise systems via Salesforce's existing connector infrastructure.

agent_interoperability.mcp_support: Yes. Native MCP client in pilot (July 2025). Enterprise-grade MCP Server registry with security policy enforcement, identity management, rate-limiting, and access protocols. Enables agents to connect to any MCP-compliant server without custom code.
agent_interoperability.a2a_support: Yes. Native A2A (Agent-to-Agent Protocol) support enabling standardized, secure communication between Salesforce agents and external AI agents regardless of underlying platform. Provides digital identity and structured collaboration framework for task decomposition and delegation.
agent_interoperability.agents_md_support: No specific AGENTS.md support documented. Agentforce uses its own declarative YAML configuration files and Agent Script for defining agent roles, behaviors, and states.
agent_interoperability.cross_framework_compatibility: Strong interoperability through MCP and A2A protocol adoption. AgentExchange marketplace facilitates discovery of third-party agents and tools. BYOLLM connector enables integration with any language model. Open platform strategy with partnerships across OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, AWS, and Azure. However, the platform is primarily designed for the Salesforce ecosystem, so deep integration with non-Salesforce enterprise systems requires MCP servers or custom connectors.

safety_and_guardrails.permission_model: capability_based with attribute-based access control (ABAC). Agents operate within the existing Salesforce security model including profiles, permission sets, and sharing rules. Enterprise-grade MCP Server registry enforces security policies, identity management, and access protocols for external tool access. Flow isolation ensures agents cannot exceed their authorized scope.
safety_and_guardrails.escalation_policy: Configurable escalation to human agents based on complexity, confidence thresholds, or business rules. Agent Script enables deterministic escalation paths for critical scenarios. Agents can be configured to always involve humans for specific decision types while autonomously handling routine tasks.
safety_and_guardrails.hallucination_mitigation: Multi-layered approach: (1) Dynamic grounding via Data Cloud — responses anchored in enterprise data. (2) Atlas 'System 2' inference-time reasoning with reflection loops — agent evaluates and refines responses before delivery. (3) Einstein Trust Layer includes toxicity detection, data masking, and output validation. (4) Agent Script deterministic workflows ensure critical business logic always runs correctly regardless of LLM output. (5) Zero Data Retention with LLMs prevents data leakage.
safety_and_guardrails.audit_trail: Yes. Comprehensive audit trail tracking all AI agent actions and outputs. Every Atlas decision — planning, tool selection, action execution, and reflection — is logged. Token-level telemetry tracks usage per step for cost optimization and LLM performance monitoring. AI monitoring captures interactions in event logs for each user interaction.
safety_and_guardrails.human_oversight_pattern: confidence_threshold and pre-approval (configurable). Hybrid reasoning via Agent Script allows deterministic control over critical paths with LLM flexibility elsewhere. Agents can be configured for full autonomy on routine tasks with human approval required for high-stakes decisions. Post-review available through comprehensive audit trail and monitoring dashboards.

governance_and_standards.governance_body: Salesforce (proprietary platform). Salesforce contributes to and implements open protocols including MCP (Anthropic) and A2A (Google). Salesforce AI Research incubated the Atlas Reasoning Engine.
governance_and_standards.contributing_protocols: MCP (Model Context Protocol) — native client support. A2A (Agent-to-Agent Protocol) — native support for cross-platform interoperability. Salesforce published its own Agentic Enterprise Index and Connectivity Report establishing industry benchmarks for agentic AI adoption.
governance_and_standards.regulatory_compliance: SOC2, HIPAA, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, IRAP, FedRAMP High certifications. GDPR-aligned data processing with Data Protection Impact Assessments. EU AI Act readiness — Salesforce's Acceptable Use Policy and AI Acceptable Use Policy align with the AI Act's ban list. Data masking, audit logging, ABAC, and flow isolation support compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, and SOX requirements. Zero Data Retention with external LLMs. Over 2,000 pages of AI-specific compliance documentation.

deployment_and_operations.deployment_modes: cloud, managed_service. Salesforce is a cloud-native SaaS platform. Agentforce runs within the Salesforce multi-tenant cloud infrastructure. No on-premise or self-hosted deployment option. Integration with external systems via MCP, A2A, and API connectors.
deployment_and_operations.scalability_model: horizontal, serverless (Salesforce managed). Built on Salesforce's hyperscale multi-tenant architecture. Asynchronous, event-driven, graph-based workflows with concurrent design principles enable high throughput. Automatic scaling managed by Salesforce infrastructure.
deployment_and_operations.cost_per_task: Multiple pricing models: (1) Per-conversation: $2 per conversation (from first AI response until resolution or 24h inactivity). (2) Flex Credits (action-based): $0.10 per completed action (20 Flex Credits each); packs of 100,000 credits at $500. (3) Per-user licensing: Agentforce Add-ons starting at $125/user/month for unlimited internal agent usage with templates, automation, and analytics. Customers cannot mix Flex Credits and Conversations in the same org.
deployment_and_operations.resource_requirements: No infrastructure required — fully managed SaaS. Requires active Salesforce subscription (Enterprise Edition or higher recommended). Data Cloud license needed for full agent context capabilities. Additional Agentforce licenses/credits purchased on top of base Salesforce subscription.

observability_and_ops.monitoring_integration: Built-in monitoring via Salesforce platform. Einstein Trust Layer audit trail for AI-specific monitoring. Token-level telemetry for cost and performance tracking. AI monitoring event logs. Integration with Salesforce's existing admin tools, dashboards, and reporting. Agentic Enterprise Index provides benchmarking data.
observability_and_ops.tracing_support: Yes. Every Atlas Reasoning Engine decision is logged including planning, tool selection, action execution, and reflection steps. Full execution traces available for debugging agent behavior. Token-level telemetry per step for performance analysis.
observability_and_ops.production_readiness_level: enterprise_grade. 18,500+ deals closed since launch, 9,500+ paid deals, 12,000+ active customers. Used by enterprises including Reddit, SharkNinja, Indeed, Heathrow Airport, Grupo Globo, Fisher & Paykel. Salesforce-managed infrastructure with enterprise SLAs, compliance certifications, and 24/7 support.

adoption_and_market.github_stars: N/A (proprietary SaaS platform, not open-source). Salesforce has the 'einstein-platform' GitHub repository for developer tools, but the core Agentforce platform is not open-source.
adoption_and_market.adoption_scale: 18,500+ Agentforce deals closed since launch. 9,500+ paid deals (up 50% quarter-over-quarter). 12,000+ active customers on Agentforce 360. 70% quarter-over-quarter growth in customers in production. 119% agent growth in first half of 2025 per Salesforce's Agentic Enterprise Index. Notable customers: Reddit (46% case deflection, 84% faster resolution), SharkNinja, Indeed, Heathrow Airport, Big Brothers Big Sisters, Fisher & Paykel, Grupo Globo (22% retention improvement in under 3 months). Rapid UK adoption reported December 2025.
adoption_and_market.pricing_model: Per-conversation ($2/conversation), per-action via Flex Credits ($0.10/action), or per-user licensing ($125+/user/month). Enterprise agreements available. Requires base Salesforce subscription.
adoption_and_market.key_use_cases: Customer service automation (Tier-1/2 inquiry handling, case deflection), sales operations (pipeline management, lead qualification, prospecting), marketing automation, commerce (order management, product discovery), financial services (voice AI for banking and collections), account management, data pipeline orchestration. Industries: Media & Entertainment, Financial Services, Retail, Hospitality, Automotive, Healthcare, Publishing, Talent Recruitment.
adoption_and_market.competitive_position: Leading enterprise CRM-native agentic AI platform. Direct competitors: Microsoft Copilot/Copilot Studio (broader M365 ecosystem, more copilot-style assistance vs. Agentforce's autonomy focus), ServiceNow AI Agents (stronger in ITSM, ranked #1 in 2025 Gartner Critical Capabilities for Building/Managing AI Agents). Salesforce differentiates on CRM-depth, autonomous agent capability, and unified data layer. Broader AI agents market projected at $7.84B in 2025 growing to $52.62B by 2030 (CAGR 46.3%). Marc Benioff has positioned Agentforce as fundamentally different from 'copilot' approaches, controversially calling Microsoft Copilot 'Clippy 2.0'.

Trailhead provides free learning paths, certifications, and hands-on challenges. Agentblazer Status program incentivizes Agentforce skill development. Salesforce Ben, Salesforce Developers Blog, and numerous third-party blogs provide extensive coverage. Annual Dreamforce conference (180,000+ attendees) heavily features Agentforce.

Agentforce Developer Guide, Models and Prompts Guide, and Agent Builder documentation available. Salesforce Engineering Blog publishes deep technical architecture articles. Trailhead modules provide guided, hands-on learning with sandbox environments.
ecosystem_maturity.third_party_integrations_count: Extensive — AgentExchange marketplace with growing catalog of pre-built agents, skills, and tools. Thousands of existing Salesforce AppExchange integrations. MCP support opens connectivity to any MCP-compliant tool. Exact Agentforce-specific integration count not publicly disclosed but Salesforce's broader ecosystem includes 7,000+ AppExchange apps.
ecosystem_maturity.tutorial_availability: Extensive. Trailhead modules and trails dedicated to Agentforce (free). Agentforce Workshop for developers. Agentblazer learning paths. Salesforce-certified AI Associate and AI Specialist credentials. Numerous blog posts, videos, and press resources. Salesforce+ streaming content on Agentforce. Third-party training from Salesforce Ben, Cirra, ConcretIO, and others.

human_agent_interaction.autonomy_spectrum: assistant to autonomous (configurable). Can operate as a fully autonomous agent handling end-to-end workflows without human intervention, or as an assistant requiring human approval for specific actions. Agent Script enables hybrid mode where deterministic paths handle critical logic while LLM reasoning handles conversational nuance.
human_agent_interaction.handoff_mechanism: Configurable escalation to human agents through Salesforce Service Cloud's existing routing infrastructure. When agents detect complexity beyond their scope or confidence falls below thresholds, cases are seamlessly transferred to human agents with full conversation context and agent reasoning history. Voice handoff supported for Agentforce Voice interactions.
human_agent_interaction.feedback_loop: Agent behavior refined through Agentforce Builder's conversational testing workspace. Admin-configurable guardrails and Agent Script allow iterative improvement. Atlas Reasoning Engine's reflection loops enable self-improvement during execution. Audit trail data informs agent optimization. Salesforce's Agentic Enterprise Index provides benchmarking data for continuous improvement.

entrepreneurial_relevance.startup_applicability: Agentforce is primarily designed for enterprises already invested in the Salesforce ecosystem. For startups: (1) WHEN TO USE — if you are already a Salesforce customer and need to automate CRM-centric workflows (customer service, sales ops, lead management), Agentforce provides a fast, no-code/low-code path to deploying AI agents with enterprise-grade security and compliance. The $2/conversation or $0.10/action pricing can be cost-effective for specific high-volume use cases. (2) WHEN TO AVOID — Agentforce requires a base Salesforce subscription which is expensive for early-stage startups ($125+/user/month for add-ons alone, plus base CRM costs). It is tightly coupled to the Salesforce ecosystem, making it less suitable if you don't use Salesforce. For general-purpose agentic AI, open-source alternatives (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) or cloud-native options (AWS Bedrock Agents, Google ADK) offer more flexibility at lower cost. (3) STRATEGIC INSIGHT — Agentforce represents the 'embedded AI agent' trend where major SaaS platforms add native agentic capabilities. Startups should watch this trend: it means your customers may expect agent-like automation built into your product, not as a separate AI tool.
entrepreneurial_relevance.build_vs_buy: BUY if you are a Salesforce-centric organization needing CRM workflow automation — Agentforce's native integration, enterprise security, and managed infrastructure eliminate significant engineering effort. BUILD (or use alternatives) if you need custom agent behavior beyond CRM workflows, want to avoid Salesforce lock-in, or have budget constraints typical of early-stage startups. The per-action pricing ($0.10) can be attractive for high-volume, low-complexity tasks, but costs add up quickly for complex multi-step agent workflows. Consider hybrid: use Agentforce for CRM-facing agents, open-source frameworks for custom/internal agents.
entrepreneurial_relevance.session_mapping: 3, 4. Session 3 (AI project framing — Build vs Buy, managed AI platforms as an option), Session 4 (AI business models — consumption-based pricing, enterprise AI platforms, SaaS-embedded AI trends).

confidence.data_quality: High. Information sourced primarily from Salesforce official press releases, investor relations, engineering blog, developer documentation, Trailhead, and reputable third-party analysts (Salesforce Ben, TechTarget, Fortune, Gartner references). Adoption numbers from Salesforce investor communications.
confidence.cross_reference: Salesforce investor relations (18,500+ deals, 12,000 customers), Salesforce Engineering Blog (Atlas architecture), Salesforce Developer Docs (supported models, MCP support), Salesforce News (Agentforce 360, Spring '26), Salesforce Ben (competitive analysis, feature coverage), Concret.io and Aquiva Labs (pricing analysis), TechTarget and Fortune (market positioning), multiple third-party blogs corroborating technical details.
confidence.caveats: Agentforce is evolving rapidly — new versions released roughly quarterly (Oct 2024, Dec 2024, Mar 2025, Jun 2025, Oct 2025, Feb 2026). Pricing models have already shifted significantly (from $2/conversation to flexible credits). Adoption numbers are Salesforce-reported and may include trials/pilots alongside production deployments. MCP client is still in pilot as of early 2026. The platform is tightly coupled to Salesforce ecosystem — evaluating it independently from the broader Salesforce investment is difficult. ServiceNow ranked higher in Gartner's 2025 agent management report, suggesting competitive positioning may shift.
